_comment: Discoverable MCP server config fragment. Parent integrates selected entries; none are startup-eager. All entries verified 2026-09-07 (see docs/integrations/mcp.md for the per-tool test matrix). Credentials are referenced via ${ENV_VAR}, never inlined. Paths under integrations/mcp/venvs are isolated per-server lanes owned by this integration; source paths point at the user-supplied server sources.

workshop-calculator._verified: 4/4 tools listed; add, multiply invoked OK

workshop-weather._verified: 3/3 tools listed; get_alerts, get_current_weather invoked OK against live NWS API

workshop-calendar._verified: 7/7 tools listed; get_current_datetime, list_events, weekday_to_date invoked OK. Writes calendar_events.json to cwd - keep cwd pointed at scratch.

workshop-email-history._verified: 2/2 tools listed; get_emails, get_email_by_id invoked OK (empty store - reads email_history.json from cwd)

workshop-task-manager._verified: 4/4 tools listed; list_tasks invoked OK. NOTE: source hardcodes mcp.run(port=8001) which current mcp SDK rejects; launched via `mcp run ... --transport streamable-http` per upstream SDK, binds 8000. Port 8000 collides with the healthcare HTTP mode and common dev ports - launch on demand only.

healthcare._verified: 11 tools listed; 9 invoked OK without API keys (calculate_bmi, fda_drug_lookup, pubmed_search, lookup_icd_code, health_topics, clinical_trials_search, ncbi_bookshelf_search, medrxiv_search, get_usage_stats). API keys optional - raise rate limits only. Do NOT copy keys from the repo .env.example; supply your own via env.

cms-coverage._verified: 93 tools generated from OpenAPI spec; getMetadataStateId, getMetadataContractType invoked OK. NOTE: repo README base URL https://api.cms.gov/mcd does not resolve (DNS failure); correct host is https://api.coverage.cms.gov. /v1/data/* endpoints return 401 without a CMS Coverage API license token (MCD license agreement) - metadata/reports endpoints are public.

strands-docs._verified: 2/2 tools listed; search_docs invoked OK. Package archived upstream 2026-07 (moved to strands-agents/harness-sdk) but PyPI artifact still functional.

strands-tools-mcp._verified: Exposes strands-agents-tools modules per STRANDS_TOOLS env; current_time + calculator invoked OK. Sets BYPASS_TOOL_CONSENT=true internally - only list safe read-only tool modules in STRANDS_TOOLS.

strands-mcp-server-cagatay._verified: PARTIAL: initialize + list_tools OK (mcp_client, greet from tools/ hot-reload). Tool invocation blocked by upstream bug: strands ConcurrencyException 'Direct tool call cannot be made while the agent is in the middle of an invocation' - the package holds its Agent mid-invocation while serving; needs upstream fix (record_direct_tool_call=False).

strands-agent-realestate._verified: PARTIAL: initialize + list_tools OK (real_estate_expert). Tool NOT invoked: it spins an Agent on Bedrock model us.amazon.nova-pro-v1:0 - requires AWS credentials with Bedrock access; invoking without them fails and with them incurs model spend.

electron-playwright-mcp._verified: PARTIAL: initialize + list_tools OK (37 tools: cdp_*, electron_*, playwright_*, request_approval). Read-only calls failed: backend Electron runtime not running (localhost:3000/electron responded 404 from an unrelated Next dev server; :9222 and :8931 closed). Requires an Electron app with `import 'electron-playwright-mcp/register'` running to expose the three OpenAPI surfaces.

mcp-installer._verified: initialize + list_tools OK (install_repo_mcp_server, install_local_mcp_server). Both tools MUTATE (install packages / emit config) - no read-only tool exists, so none were invoked by policy. Enable only when deliberate installs are wanted.
